_README: NUTS unit → the region label the sidebar already uses for that country's wines, for the countries whose region facet is an administrative tier: Spain (comunidad autónoma = NUTS-2), Italy (regione = NUTS-2; the two autonomous provinces are one regione), Austria (Bundesland = NUTS-2), Germany (Bundesland = NUTS-1), the Netherlands (provincie = NUTS-2), Belgium (gewest = NUTS-1). A drink whose drawn units all lie in one of these is filed under it (scripts/_lib/drinks/region.py); one that spans several, and every drink of a country whose wine regions are not administrative units (Portugal, Greece, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania, Croatia, Slovenia, Slovakia, Czechia, Cyprus), is filed under the country unless it shares the area of a wine record (`ref:` in areas.json), whose region it then takes. The labels are spelled exactly as the wine pipelines spell them; tests/test_drinks_geometry.py checks every code against the GISCO layers.
